title: FreeRTOS on ESP32: Arduino and ESP-IDF

questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “FreeRTOS on ESP32: Arduino and ESP-IDF”?
options: ESP32 family members do not all have the same radios and peripherals.
Queues pass messages and decouple tasks.
The ESP32 name alone does not guarantee pin or radio compatibility; check the exact part.
ESP-IDF selects the chip target before building.
questions.answer: Queues pass messages and decouple tasks.
questions.explanation:
Queues pass messages and decouple tasks.
Why: ESP-IDF uses FreeRTOS tasks and queues to separate work. Measure stack, priority, affinity, and blocking; a stalled task may trigger a watchdog.
